Perfect! All 72 tests pass. I've successfully created the text rendering functionality:

**src/render.js:**
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` — Renders an invoice as plain text with:
  - Invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
  - Customer name (looked up from catalogue if not already in invoice)
  - One line per item showing qty, product name, unit price (via `formatEuros`), and line total (via `formatEuros`)
  - Total line showing sum of all line totals (via `formatEuros`)

**test/render.test.js:** 13 comprehensive tests covering:
- Draft vs issued invoices
- Proper `formatEuros` formatting for all amounts
- Multiple invoice lines in correct order
- Different customers, VAT rates (0%, 9%, 21%), and quantities
- Totals matching sum of lines
- Enriched invoices with customer info
- Output format validation

All 72 tests pass.
